rows.objection: The +1329.818726 kg and 0.689107645 values are correct at the filed grid points, but are not the best attainable values under the same continuous model.
rows.evidence: CONSTRUCTIVE-POINTS.json: +1127.071353 kg at least SF 1.000001080; fixed-mass least SF 0.699691806. Two starts converge.
rows.proposed_fix: Label the old results as attained grid values. Append the constructive designs, report the continuous search domain, and refine around the adequacy boundary. Do not assert a global optimum.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: The handbook's .425 recommendation is represented as applying only for psi about 28 or more.
rows.evidence: SOURCE-CHECK.md: IDH p4.1.012 supplies no numeric psi gate. CR-62257 p181 describes only a central accurately machined region and stronger surrounding support.
rows.proposed_fix: Attribute psi>=28 to the model author, disclose calibration nu=.33/.35 and design versus as-built geometry, and seek a demonstrated transfer before calling it handbook credit.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: gamma_s>=10 and equal-area circular-cap mapping are used to grant clamped-cap behavior to triangular sandwich bays.
rows.evidence: SUPPLEMENTARY.json: composite gamma_s 10.400178 versus isolated-member EI/(a Dskin) 3.196840. Circumscribed-circle substitution gives panel SF .390794 versus .710384.
rows.proposed_fix: Validate translational and rotational edge restraint, joint compliance, triangular geometry and shear-flexible skin together. Compare multiple bay/frame stiffness ratios including below and above 10; replace the abrupt gate with validated behavior.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: The global wavelength cutoff leaves intermediate frame/bay modes unverified; the continuum length is not the actual 026 frame length.
rows.evidence: SUPPLEMENTARY.json: 3.427772 m unrestricted minimum versus 4.08 m cutoff; global SF 1.055069 versus 1.118206. 026 arc length 2161.451 m versus continuum 2133.882 m; unchanged Be tubes add 8.093 kg.
rows.proposed_fix: Use a discrete, coupled frame/bay model covering the intervening wavelengths, eccentric constitutive coupling, real joint locations and arc lengths. Retain the continuum model as a screen.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: The narrative says Q, scarf and tubes must move after adding the O5 mass deficit.
rows.evidence: EXTENDED-ARITHMETIC.json: at the owner's +1329.818726 kg point, wrinkle/scarf/tube-local SF are 1.059449/1.109144/1.055118 using today's assumptions.
rows.proposed_fix: Separate fixed-mass failures from mass-added feasibility. Keep the seam-dependent finite-search result qualified by its model and search domain; no impossibility theorem was proved.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: The source's printed plain-Ti .33 ratio and literal .14 at a sphere are repeated as checked values.
rows.evidence: SOURCE-CHECK.md: 317/917=.345692475; SP-8032's .14+3.2/lambda^2 is greater than .14 for finite lambda. The filed C2b cap factor is .601013192, not the rounded-lambda .603.
rows.proposed_fix: Record numerator, denominator, exact calculation and printed source value separately. Describe .14 as the large-lambda limit and use the full-precision bay factor.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: LIT-STIFF treats the 759,000 and 754,000 lb predictions as conflicting source values.
rows.evidence: STA8.1 PDF p4 distinguishes geometry refinement from the additional nonuniform-loading refinement. Relative errors against 743,000 lb are 2.153% and 1.480%.
rows.proposed_fix: Assign separate model identities to the two predictions. Flag the intermediate model's incorrect 1.5% prose label. Clarify total versus web stiffener height instead of declaring an unexplained geometry contradiction.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: SiC tube capacity uses the thermal compression envelope while line force and sleeve mass use only mechanical compression.
rows.evidence: SUPPLEMENTARY.json: 55.521 kN mechanical versus 63.974 kN compression envelope; difference 8.454 kN. This does not affect the Be-on-Be thermal comparison.
rows.proposed_fix: Build signed hot/cold equilibrium cases and propagate member forces through sleeve, bond, core-line and peel calculations. Do not combine incompatible hot-face and cold-tube envelopes as one physical load case.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: Several numeric choices are recoverable but missing from the supplied inputs or compact geometry.
rows.evidence: METHOD.md: fillet density 1250 kg/m3 inferred from mass. SUPPLEMENTARY.json: calibration nu=.33/.35. Four gs5 compact rows omit shape and required psi-based recovery.
rows.proposed_fix: Publish these inputs and each chosen section's shape with units and provenance. Keep all independent check limitations visible. Preserve measured elapsed values; their microsecond timestamp differences are harmless.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed

rows.objection: Unity in the scored factors does not close material, bond, peel, residual-stress or thin-wall validation.
rows.evidence: The reconstruction retains 345 MPa tensile-as-compression, historical 379.2 MPa endpoint, typical core values, 10 MPa scarf, r/t=300 tube local rule and ideal composite action. A pin-ended Euler screen is 8.675 at the filed Be O5 point, but is not a full frame test.
rows.proposed_fix: Keep an explicit unscored-mode/load-case ledger and ground formed-gauge compression, core at lines, scarf/bond/peel and imperfect thin tubes at representative boundaries. Do not convert the conditional mass-added point into a hull qualification.
rows.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed
